name: assertOS
title: Returns the value when it is one of the named operating systems, and this machine is one of them

origin.description: Returns the value when it is one of the named operating systems, and this machine is one of them. Otherwise it stops with the check message.

arguments.name: os
arguments.text: Operating system name: linux, mac, windows, or solaris.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
